label.en: Ignore it, or use it for target practice

note.zh: “这与我们无关”或（仅狂暴灭绝者）“拿来练靶”（凝聚力收入）：逃生舱被放弃，不会再有第二次机会。
note.en: “This does not concern us” or, for homicidal empires only, “Use it as target practice” (a unity income): the pod is abandoned, and there is no second chance.

label.zh: 梅赛德斯·罗梅罗：招募窗口

note.zh: 布洛葛合众国的探险家兼外交官现身。三段对话后可聘用（不朽、206岁的杰出官员，具“布洛葛的洞见”特质）或遣散。
note.en: Blorg Commonality explorer and diplomat appears. After three dialogue-only questions she can be hired—an immortal, 206-year-old renowned official with Blorg Insight—or dismissed.

notes.zh: 起点：每次裂隙探索完成时 on_astral_rift_exploration_complete 的 random_events（权重 1 对 49 个空位，即 1/50；00_on_actions.txt:5023-5026）触发隐藏事件 6095。条件：本国物种不是 Blorg 肖像（fun12），没有预设的 Blorg 国家，全局标记 mercedes_spawned 未设。玩家必定得到；AI 只有 1/21 的二次随机。全局只会出现一次。
notes.en: Start: each time a rift exploration completes, the random_events of on_astral_rift_exploration_complete (weight 1 against 49 empty, i.e. 1 in 50; 00_on_actions.txt:5023-5026) fires hidden event 6095. Conditions: the species is not the Blorg portrait (fun12), no prescripted Blorg country exists, and global flag mercedes_spawned is not set. A player always gets it; an AI passes an extra 1-in-21 roll. It can happen only once per game.

scope.zh: 已核对 6095 / 6100 / 6105 与 on_astral_rift_exploration_complete 的随机事件项。
scope.en: Checked 6095 / 6100 / 6105 and the random_events entry of on_astral_rift_exploration_complete.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that empire appears here.
